newsitem.title: USA: Depotech sold 1.5 mln newly issued shares.
newsitem.headline: Depotech sold 1.5 mln newly issued shares.

text.p: DepoTech Corp said it sold 1.5 million newly issued shares of its common stock to unaffiliated institutional investors and others, at a price of $13.50 per share.
It said it expects to use proceeds to fund research, and commercialization of its products, and for repayment of new and existing equipment lease lines and for general corporate purposes.
DepoTech is a drug delivery company developing "sustained-release" treatments based on its injectable drug delivery technology.
